= Link roles and browser attributes

Underline URL: https://example.com/underline[Underlined,role=underline]

Struck link: link:https://example.com/struck[Struck,role=line-through]

Large link: link:https://example.com/large[Large,role=big]

Small mailto: mailto:person@example.com[Small,role=small]

Combined roles: link:https://example.com/combined[Combined,role="big underline"]

Unknown role: link:https://example.com/custom[Custom,role=custom]

Button role: link:https://example.com/button[Button,role=button]

Plain control: link:https://example.com/plain[Same]

Window: link:https://example.com/window[Same,window=_blank]

Target: link:https://example.com/target[Same,target=reader]

Title: link:https://example.com/title[Same,title="Browser tooltip"]

Nofollow: link:https://example.com/nofollow[Same,opts=nofollow]

Noopener: link:https://example.com/noopener[Same,window=_blank,opts=noopener]

Relation: link:https://example.com/relation[Same,rel=nofollow]

Window shorthand: link:https://example.com/shorthand[Same^]
